scores.visual_critic_note: Clean control toolbar and muted blue/red palette show design intent, but the circle-pack visualization is clipped at the bottom of its container — the main content never fully renders in view — and the edge bundles collapse into an unreadable dark tangle that obscures the hierarchical structure they're meant to show.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correctly uses scaleSqrt for force-layout node sizing and data-driven domains with key functions on joins, but applying scaleSqrt to the sunburst's radial axis distorts ring area proportions relative to the linear partition values.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing param sliders fire a full 1500ms updateLayout() on every input event with no debounce or RAF, and no .interrupt() is called before new layout transitions begin, leaving mid-flight tweens competing to write d.current_x/y simultaneously.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The circle pack hierarchy reads clearly (2-color groups, nested structure) but the edge bundle overlay creates a dense spaghetti tangle of converging lines at leaf nodes that is unresolvable without hover interaction, and the 8-layout control panel adds significant UI overhead that competes for attention before the viewer even engages with the data.
